docs.pageDescription: How blocks and code work in the calculator builder. This page is generated automatically from the formula registry.
docs.intro:
Use **blocks** in the visual editor or **code** in the script sheet — both use the same language. Search below or browse by category.

New operators and functions appear here automatically when added to the platform.

plus.title: Addition (+)
plus.blockUsage: Drag the **+** operator between two blocks in the formula workspace.

minus.title: Subtraction (−)
minus.description: Subtracts the right value from the left.
minus.blockUsage: Drag **−** between blocks, e.g. revenue minus cost.

divide.title: Division (÷)
divide.description: Divides the left value by the right. Division by zero shows a warning and returns 0.

gt.title: Greater than (>)
gt.description: Returns 1 when the left value is greater than the right, otherwise 0.
gt.blockUsage: Use in code or drag **>** between blocks, e.g. for IF conditions.

lt.title: Less than (<)
lt.description: Returns 1 when the left value is smaller than the right, otherwise 0.
lt.blockUsage: Use in code or drag **<** between blocks.

gte.title: Greater or equal (≥)
gte.description: Returns 1 when the left value is greater than or equal to the right, otherwise 0.
gte.blockUsage: Type **>=** in code or drag **≥** from the palette.

lte.title: Less or equal (≤)
lte.description: Returns 1 when the left value is less than or equal to the right, otherwise 0.
lte.blockUsage: Type **<=** in code or drag **≤** from the palette.

eq.title: Equal (==)
eq.description: Returns 1 when both values are equal, otherwise 0.
eq.blockUsage: Type **==** in code or drag **=** from the palette.

neq.title: Not equal (≠)
neq.blockUsage: Type **!=** in code or drag **≠** from the palette.

sum.title: SUM
sum.blockUsage: Drag **SUM** from the palette and fill the inner slots with values to add.

count.title: COUNT
count.blockUsage: Drag **COUNT** and add values inside the brackets.

avg.title: AVG
avg.blockUsage: Drag **AVG** from aggregates in the palette.

sum-rows.title: SUM_ROWS
sum-rows.description: Sum of an expression evaluated for each row in a line-items table.
sum-rows.blockUsage: Under a line-items field, drag **SUM rows** and build the per-row formula inside.

count-rows.title: COUNT_ROWS
count-rows.description: Number of rows in a line-items table (same expression evaluated per row for consistency).
count-rows.blockUsage: Use **COUNT rows** from the line-items group in the palette.

avg-rows.title: AVG_ROWS
avg-rows.description: Average of an expression over all rows in a line-items table.
avg-rows.blockUsage: Drag **AVG rows** for a table field.

min-rows.title: MIN_ROWS
min-rows.description: Minimum of an expression across table rows.

max-rows.title: MAX_ROWS
max-rows.description: Maximum of an expression across table rows.

if.title: IF
if.description: Picks the second value when the condition is non-zero, otherwise the third.
if.blockUsage: Drag **IF** and fill condition, then-branch, and else-branch.

quantity.title: Quantity (.qty)
quantity.description: User-entered quantity for an input field.
quantity.blockUsage: Drag the field's quantity chip from the palette.

property.title: Property (.var_*)
property.description: A numeric property on an input (cost, price, etc.).
property.blockUsage: Drag a property block under its field group.

constant.title: Constant
constant.description: Fixed value defined in calculator constants.
constant.blockUsage: Drag a constant from the palette into the formula.

calculation.title: Calculation
calculation.blockUsage: Drag a calculation reference when building outputs or other calcs.

row-property.title: Row property (row.*)
row-property.description: Property of the current row inside SUM_ROWS / line-items formulas.
row-property.blockUsage: Inside a row aggregate bracket, use row property blocks.

input.title: input
input.description: Declares an input field with properties and optional quantity.

constant.title: constant
constant.description: Fixed numeric constant used in formulas.

calc.title: calc
calc.description: Intermediate calculation with a formula block.

output.title: output
output.description: Final result shown to the user.
